edits.new: The Atlas Admin API create operation is POST /api/atlas/v2/groups/{groupId}/alertConfigs; it creates one alert configuration for the specified project, and groupId identifies the project (groups and projects are synonymous). Sources: https://www.mongodb.com/docs/api/doc/atlas-admin-api-v2/operation/operation-creategroupalertconfig

evidence.quote: Creates one alert configuration for the specified project. Alert configurations define the triggers and notification methods for alerts.
NOTE: Groups and projects are synonymous terms. Your group id is the same as your project id.
